title: Museums & Galleries
heading: Big stories. Brilliant discoveries.
intro: You go in for a look round and suddenly there is something you cannot stop talking about. UK museums and galleries have all sorts to explore, from local stories and unusual collections to art that makes you stop in your tracks. Browse the guides and choose a subject your group will get into. Check the exhibition or activity you fancy, leave time for a proper look and find somewhere nearby for a drink afterwards. There is plenty to discover here.
